name: Proving Grounds 21: The Sunken Causeway. An old stone road through a foggy mire, by day, broken in two places: headless and weeping statues line it, its iron lanterns burn with green wisp-fire, and it ends at a ruined gatehouse where something keeps a throne of skulls.
